links.outcome: Surgeon-graded appropriateness of ChatGPT-4 answers to common post-TKA patient questions
links.effect: 44/60 (73.3%) ChatGPT answers appropriate, same as nurses; 5 graded inappropriate, 0 unreliable (nurses: 4 inappropriate, 1 unreliable).
links.quote: For the ChatGPT response, there were 5 responses graded "inappropriate" and no responses graded "unreliable."

unlisted_practices: Patient preference and comfort comparison between AI and nurse answers to postoperative questions

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT responses compared to arthroplasty-trained nurses on post-TKA patient questions using surgeon expert review and patient survey ratings of comfort/trust.
